name: body
description: The main prose of a section or concept, written as markdown.

aiGuidance.purpose: Short paragraphs, concrete and technical, naming the mechanism. Show the structure instead of describing it vaguely. State only what the records of this repository state: no issue, ticket or build identifiers, no counts of records or tests, and no claims about capability, maturity or stability that another record does not make. Describe SRS as a standard for portable semantic documents. Never use an em dash.
